diagnosis: The first control made 23 successful model calls. Its twenty-fourth response returned HTTP 200 with finish_reason length and exactly the 2,048-token output cap, so transport retained usage and raised glm.incomplete-output.
interpretation: This is a model output-budget exhaustion, not a tokenizer, network, credential, state-fitting, or source-integrity failure. H14 had zero treatment exposure and remains untested. A common bounded correction can ask for one concise action while charging the failed and corrective calls to the same model-token cap.
retention_rule: Retain the attempt and fifteen unstarted cells. Do not rerun round eight. Add one explicit budgeted output-cap correction common to both arms and freeze a separately versioned successor.
